name: pumpkin-spice-design-system
description: Pumpkin Spice Design System: design tokens, Drupal SDC Twig components, React components, and Lit web components built on one shared CSS layer.

scripts.build: npm run tokens && npm run ensure-dist && vite build --config node_modules/@emulsify/core/config/vite/vite.config.js
scripts.build:packages: npm run tokens && npm run build -w @pumpkin-spice/web-components -w @pumpkin-spice/react
scripts.develop: npm run tokens && npm run ensure-dist && concurrently --raw --no-shell npm:vite npm:storybook
scripts.storybook-build: npm run build && storybook build -c node_modules/@emulsify/core/.storybook -o .out
